args.title: Fix failure on CSV files ending with an empty line in parseStatement
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Change parseStatement to properly handle CSV files that end with an empty line without throwing a 'Malformed row' error. The fix involves ensuring the final blank line is not treated as a data row by trimming or robustly ignoring trailing empty lines, allowing import of files with trailing newlines as is common in statement exports.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The parser throws a 'Malformed row' error for CSV files ending with a blank line, such as exported statements with trailing newlines. The root cause is that the final blank line is incorrectly counted as a malformed data row. The fix is to adjust parseStatement in src/ingest/parser.ts to ignore trailing empty lines more robustly.
